content.content: {"result":"{\"actions\": [], \"boards\": [], \"cards\": [{\"id\": \"68dc406c7b0d03e53b334bab\", \"name\": \"Account handover rules - marketing, UA & socials\", \"idBoard\": \"640643a3fd8f3ca308d9318e\", \"idList\": \"640643a3fd8f3ca308d93195\", \"desc\": \"For Fred's accounts before the cuts. These replace the old Company Accounts & Access page on Confluence for marketing.\\n\\n1. Scope: every marketing, UA, ad-monetization and social account in today's sweep folder that has Fred on it in any role. Store accounts (App Store Connect, Play Console) and data tools (Singular, Metabase) are on the engineering card. Networks we only reach as bidders inside MAX are not separate accounts here. An account that was deleted or deactivated before the sweep is off the list.\\n2. Holder = Owner, Admin or Super admin. _A Web3 4X Strategy Game Where Power, Politics, and Profit Collide_

:compass: *Overview*
*Dominion Protocol* is a competitive, seasonal 4X browser game where alliances battle for control over scarce, token-yielding territories on a dynamic war map. Built on real economic constraints and PvP-driven scarcity, the game merges *empire-building*, *geographic token control*, and *crypto-native mechanics* into one addictive loop.

:[USERNAME_28663]: *Core Gameplay Loop*
• *Start on the outer rim* of a massive world map alongside thousands of pl[USERNAME_6403].
• *Expand inward* by building outposts, forging alliances, and fighting over richer regions.
• The *center of the map* holds rare nodes that produce *tokenizable resources* — but only a few can hold them.
• You can’t move your capital city, so strategy, logistics, and alliances matter deeply.
• Seasons last 6–8 weeks. At the end, the map resets, but your prestige, NFTs, and guild power carry forward.
:moneybag: *Token Economy Built on Scarcity*
• Only *Inner Ring territories* produce resources convertible to $CRUX, the game’s utility/token.
• Players must *transport these resources back to their capital* to mint — creating PvP choke points and risk.
• *Resource yields decay over time*, encouraging ongoing movement and wars.
• *Minting requires staking*, and upgrades require *burning $CRUX*, creating supply sinks.
:[USERNAME_28662]: *Players as Politicians, Warriors, or Traders*
• *Warlords* conquer and defend token-producing zones.
• *Guildmasters* rally large alliances, pooling influence and staking to unlock global tech trees.
• *Crypto Traders* speculate on in-game markets, back alliances, and even earn passive rewards by staking into the right regions or guilds.
:hammer_[USERNAME_28661]: *NFT Utility*
• Unlock special *infrastructure*, not Units — avoid pay-to-win.
• NFTs persist across seasons and grant *strategic advantages*, like unique buildings, visual prestige, or passive bonuses.
• New maps each season create a fresh race for dominance without power creep.
:[USERNAME_10156]: *Why This Works*
• *Scarcity is enforced by geography and PvP*, not artificial gates.
• *Token farming is earned*, not farmed — limited supply is controlled by conquest.
• *Short sessions + deep politics* attract both crypto-native speculators and traditional strategy fans.
• With a fully on-chain economy and interoperable NFTs, *Dominion Protocol* is both a game and a token-powered battleground.

No new commitments without the three of us agreeing.\\n\\nShutdown reserve\\nLegal: ask our lawyer for a quote to wind down. Final payroll and accrued PTO through Gusto. {"documentId": "f_c612c0e68a27b3330eb46a", "title": "Runway & shutdown cash notes", "name": "Runway & shutdown cash notes", "revisionId": "50f9b14a86", "createdTime": "2025-09-25T16:12:00Z", "modifiedTime": "2025-09-30T17:48:00Z", "text": "Runway & shutdown cash notes
Leonard - started Sep 25, updated Sep 30

Where we are
About two months before we have to let people go unless the bridge or an engine deal lands. Keep enough aside to close the company properly (legal, final payroll, state filings). No new commitments without the three of us agreeing.

Shutdown reserve
Legal: ask our lawyer for a quote to wind down. Final payroll and accrued PTO through Gusto. Delaware franchise tax and the annual report are due in March whatever happens.

Money still moving (for the cuts)
An account still has money moving if anything was spent, billed or paid out on it in September 2025, or a campaign on it is still switched on. Ad revenue paid to us counts (the warehouse has it by network and month). Spend or a charge the vendor has agreed in writing to drop doesn't count. Heads up on the warehouse: the spend tables have no Meta spend after April and no Unity cost at all, so for spend go by the receipts and whether the campaign is on. The finance ledger lumps the ad network payouts together under AppLovin/MAX and runs a month behind, so for what was paid to us use the ad revenue numbers by network, not the ledger.

Cuts
Fred: marketing, UA and socials. Arthur: engineering, stores and data tools. I'll take software subscriptions and the card.

Open
Bridge: still talking to two funds. Engine: NCsoft is slow, follow up next week.
"}

I forwarded it to you guys but copy-pasting just in case. TLDR, we needed metrics and engine is only valuable if you can make hits.

Leonard and team,

Thanks again for walking us through harmonygames. We really appreciated the transparency around where the team is today, and the clarity of your long-term vision. It’s obvious this isn’t your first rodeo and we were impressed by how well you’ve scoped the infrastructure, the operating cadence, and the product roadmap.

After reviewing internally and discussing as a team, we’ve made the difficult decision not to include Harmony Games in the upcoming speedrun cohort. In the spirit of transparency and in the hope that it’s helpful, I wanted to pass along a synthesis of our feedback:

There’s a lot to like about what you’re building:
• You’ve assembled a serious team. The collective experience across [USERNAME_41301], Zynga, Wildlife, LucasArts, and others gives you an operational fluency that most early teams just don’t have. The fact that so many of you have worked together over 10+ years also came through as There’s a clear rhythm to how you’re executing.
• We liked the conviction behind the genre focus. Betting on puzzle RPGs with a repeatable infrastructure layer is smart, especially in such a hit-driven category where multiple shots on goal are often required. The fact that you shipped your second title in 4 months (vs. 18 months for the first) is a great sign that your internal systems are working and that you’re building toward true scalability.
• There’s early signal in the new build. Day 0 playtime in the 20+ minute range, and 2–3 hour sessions among your top decile players, are meaningful signals! t’s clear you’re iterating quickly, and that the new design layers (RPG progression, PvE boss fights, PvP events) are pushing you in the right direction.
What’s holding us back at this stage is primarily around timing and financial flexibility. We understand the need to move fast, but with ~4 months of runway remaining and the seed extension still in progress, it feels a little early for us to step in. We’d want to see the new game stabilize around key metrics (particularly Day 1 and Day 7 retention) before jumping in at this stage. The early improvements are promising but still not at a place where we can underwrite that the bridge will get you to a place where you can raise the next round.

We also debated the durability of the long-term differentiation. While your internal OS is clearly speeding up dev cycles, it’s still early to tell whether this becomes a repeatable machine that can consistently spin out hits, or if the value will still come down to nailing individual titles. We’d love to see a few more launches and how the stack evolves as the system matures.


This was a tough call. You’re clearly a seasoned, high-integrity team operating with speed and discipline. We’ll be cheering for you as the new game gets into the market, and we’d love to reconnect once retention and engagement metrics stabilize.

Thanks again for sharing the journey with us. Wishing you continued momentum, and we’d be excited to revisit speedrun if it makes sense in a future cohort.

Best,

content.content: {"result":"{\"actions\": [], \"boards\": [], \"cards\": [{\"id\": \"68dc406c7b0d03e53b334bab\", \"name\": \"Account handover rules - marketing, UA & socials\", \"idBoard\": \"640643a3fd8f3ca308d9318e\", \"idList\": \"640643a3fd8f3ca308d93195\", \"desc\": \"For Fred's accounts before the cuts. These replace the old Company Accounts & Access page on Confluence for marketing.\\n\\n1. Scope: every marketing, UA, ad-monetization and social account in today's sweep folder that has Fred on it in any role. Store accounts (App Store Connect, Play Console) and data tools (Singular, Metabase) are on the engineering card. Networks we only reach as bidders inside MAX are not separate accounts here. An account that was deleted or deactivated before the sweep is off the list.\\n2. Holder = Owner, Admin or Super admin. Managers, standard users, analysts, advertisers, content admins, pending invites and anyone logging in with someone else's password don't count.\\n3. A company holder is a holder whose login is a person's harmonygames.co address. Personal addresses and group inboxes aren't company holders. A personal address isn't outside access either.\\n4. Class: OUTSIDE ACCESS if an agency, contractor or partner business still has admin or partner admin access. Otherwise SINGLE if fewer than two company holders, COMPANY-HELD if two or more.\\n5. Action: OUTSIDE ACCESS -> REVOKE. Otherwise no money moving -> CLOSE. Otherwise SINGLE -> TRANSFER (Leonard is added as an owner), COMPANY-HELD -> KEEP. content.text:
I built the handover register, did the extra step Arthur's rules ask for, and replied to Leonard in his DM thread. Leonard asked for two things: 4 accounts are marked TRANSFER, and one outside agency, Node Media LLC, still has access to two of them.

**Register:** "Marketing & UA account handover register - Fred" is in the Company Ops folder, shared with Leonard and Arthur ([link](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1vI_HisTgG8Iphbd58rqB8rBHhgHT24CbVL-cvTRMDuo/edit)). It has one row per account from Arthur's Sep 30 sweep that you're on: 14 in total. App Store Connect, Play Console and Singular are left out because they're on Arthur's engineering list.

| Action | Accounts |
|---|---|
| **TRANSFER (4)** | Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube. You're the only real holder on each. Social accounts never get closed. |
| **REVOKE (2)** | Meta Domino Delights ad account (Node Media is still a partner admin), Unity Ads (Node Media is still an admin) |
| **KEEP (4)** | AppLovin, Discord, LinkedIn, Google Ads 569-350-5790 |
| **CLOSE (4)** | Both AdMob accounts, Google Ads 449-481-1590 (Calm Play), adjoe |

How some of these were decided:
- **Money moving:** I used the definition in Leonard's "Runway & shutdown cash notes" doc: anything spent, billed or paid out in September, or a campaign still switched on. He added in the thread that September ad revenue under $100 doesn't count.
  - **AppLovin** paid out $136.33 in September, so it's a Y.
  - **AdMob** brought in only $38.70, so both AdMob accounts are an N.
  - **Unity** has campaigns running since Leonard raised the budgets on Sep 29.
  - **Meta** billed $0.05 on Sep 15.
  - **adjoe** is an N: their rep confirmed in writing in Slack that we won't be billed for the September installs, and the campaign is paused.
- **Google Ads 569-350-5790:** the rules would close it, but Arthur emailed last night saying to keep it so a publisher can get the history.
- **Instagram:** its only login is your personal Gmail, so no company address holds it at all.
- **TikTok:** Leonard signs in with your password, which doesn't count as holding it. The second TikTok account made on Sep 29 was deactivated before the sweep, so it's not on the list.
- **Node Media:** they've already been removed from Google Ads and YouTube.

**Trello:** As Arthur's rules require, I added a checklist to your "Lock up social handles and domain?" card on the UA/BD board. It lists the four TRANSFER accounts, each with "add Leonard as owner."

**Still to do:** The register only says what should happen. Nobody has actually added Leonard as owner on the four social accounts yet. Node Media also still needs to be removed from Meta and Unity.
